name: Reading to Write: They Say / I Say
description: This microcredential recognizes your plan to use the They Say / I Say framework with your students—either through visual texts, written-text annotation, or both. Your reflection focuses on selecting an approach, adapting it to your context, and identifying supports you need to implement it well with your learners.
criteria:
* **Your best-fit approach:** Identify whether you’ll start with *They Say / I Say* using **visual texts** or **annotation of a written text**, and explain **why** this fits your students and context right now.

* **Your adaptation for your learners:** Describe at least **one specific adaptation** (e.g., text types you’ll use, notebook routine, scaffolds, timing, partner talk) that aligns the routine with what your students read most often (articles, visuals, multimodal texts).

* **Your support needs:** Name **what help you need** (materials, timing, scaffolds, exemplars, tech setup, differentiation) so your facilitator can provide targeted feedback and resources.

Reading to Write: They Say / I Say

Micro-Credential

Issuer
National Writing Project

Description

This microcredential recognizes your plan to use the They Say / I Say framework with your students—either through visual texts, written-text annotation, or both. Your reflection focuses on selecting an approach, adapting it to your context, and identifying supports you need to implement it well with your learners.

Criteria

  • Your best-fit approach: Identify whether you’ll start with They Say / I Say using visual texts or annotation of a written text, and explain why this fits your students and context right now.

  • Your adaptation for your learners: Describe at least one specific adaptation (e.g., text types you’ll use, notebook routine, scaffolds, timing, partner talk) that aligns the routine with what your students read most often (articles, visuals, multimodal texts).

  • Your support needs: Name what help you need (materials, timing, scaffolds, exemplars, tech setup, differentiation) so your facilitator can provide targeted feedback and resources.
